_template_note: Template for outputs/pesn/v543_dual_decoder_50k/plan/runplan.pin.json (plan §8 / §12 WP5 / ADR-0034 §6). runplan.jsonl lists concrete runs; this pin freezes the preregistered run classes and the 18-run ceiling so diagnostic / conditional runs can never be counted as formal matrix rows. Run ids must match config/campaigns/pes2ts_v543_dual_decoder_50k.yaml run_matrix exactly (appendix C). T3 = 7 decoders at seed 17, T4 = 7 decoders at seed 29, T5 <= 4 finalists at seed 43 (at most 2 per track); M0/P0 are baselines and never train; P4-C / M4 / M5 / P5 stay outside the 18 rows. This pin is the t1_start_requires record requirement runplan_pin_record: the INSTANCE is generated and verified by the WP5 runner at the runplan freeze — the WP0 schema validator --formal gate records the requirement only and NEVER reads the pin instance.

nominal.description: T3: seven formal decoders (M1, M2, M3, P1, P2, P3, P4) at seed 17, full dose 37,900 (flat, 400 warmup); T4: the same seven decoders at seed 29. M0/P0 are NOT trained here — they are the S0-A parity baselines and the per-seed comparison baseline (V543_M0_P0_recomputed).

conditional.description: T5: only the frozen per-track finalists re-run at seed 43 — at most 2 per track (MOVE top1/top2, PROCESS top1/top2), i.e. <= 4 runs. Activation is produced by the frozen screen score ranking, never by eyes on seed 17/29 results.

diagnostic.description: T1 200-update smoke (7 decoders) and T2 2,000-update diagnostic + 40+40 profile are ENGINEERING screens, not matrix rows: they never enter the 18-run ceiling, never carry H3 effect gates, and never feed winner selection.

integration.description: T7 closed-loop stress test on dev (one-shot, after T6 froze both champions). The four combos are B0 (M0+P0), BM (M*+P0), BP (M0+P*), BMP (M*+P*). Rollout is reported separately from single-step metrics and never grants deployment qualification.

conditional_generation.description: T8 Flow / Diffusion / GraphGRU are a separate identity with their own budget and report; they never enter the 18-run ceiling.

core_training_count_formula: N_core = n(T3 seed17 formal decoders) + n(T4 seed29 formal decoders) + n(T5 activated finalists) = 7 + 7 + <=4 <= 18. Every run is 37,900 updates, so the ceiling is 18 x 37,900 = 682,200 updates. smoke/diagnostic/profile/profile are technical measurements and do NOT enter N_core; T8 has its own identity and budget. N_core is always computed from the formula, NEVER by summing listed run rows.

dose_semantics.note: 37,900 flat updates with a 400-update linear warmup; the V542 W0/W1 (400 + 37,500) two-phase split is retired because the Encoder / D0 / P0 are frozen for the whole run (plan §2 difference 6). 37,500 is derived only and is never quoted as the training dose.

frozen_sequence: S0-A zero-residual parity (three seeds, CPU bitwise) -> S0-B probe / S0-C basis (WP3 go/no-go)
WP4 registry + trainer + cache; WP5 MOVE decoders; WP6 PROCESS decoders
T1 smoke 200 -> T2 diagnostic 2000 + profile 40+40 -> T3 seed17 -> T4 seed29
T5 seed43 finalists (<=2 per track) -> T6 per-track champion or retain -> T7 four combos -> T8 conditional (separate)

shared_protocol.batch: 8 curves x 4 frames stratified start/pre-TS/post-TS/endpoint; (seed, update, salt) sampler protocol

statistics_contract.p_value_rule: one-sided improvement paired cluster bootstrap: p = (1 + #{seed-averaged paired bootstrap improvement <= 0}) / 10001; CI and p share the same draws; frame-level bootstrap forbidden
statistics_contract.seed_aggregation: seed-average per draw before comparison; >=2/3 seeds same direction; every seed H2-clean
statistics_contract.holm_families: MOVE has two exits (direction and rmse) each alpha=0.025 with Holm over the eligible candidate set; PROCESS is one family over 2 endpoints x eligible candidates with alpha=0.025
statistics_contract.missing_cluster_rule: drop in both models, report the dropped count, never impute

selection_rule.eligible: three seeds complete + every seed H2-clean + H3 route pass with Holm-adjusted p < alpha
selection_rule.screen_score: MOVE: max(rmse_rel_improve/0.03, fixed_coverage_direction_rel/0.03); PROCESS: max(delta_auprc/0.02, q_mae_rel_improve/0.05, ordering_abs_improve/0.02)
selection_rule.no_candidate_rule: 该 Track 保留 M0/P0 (正常负结果, 不得事后更换 seed 或补候选)

_t1_block_rule: runplan_sha256 AND source_manifest_sha256 AND budget_policy_sha256 must be non-null before formal T1; the runplan freeze is the WP5 runner's job (the WP0 validator never reads this instance)
